Statement on Monetary Policy

June 16, 2026

1. At the Monetary Policy Meeting held today, the Policy Board decided to conduct market operations so that the uncollateralized overnight call rate will be formed at around 0.5%. The vote was 8 to 1.

2. The Bank will continue with monetary easing as long as necessary. The Bank will not hesitate to take additional easing measures if needed.

3. Japan's GDP is expected to grow by 1.2% in 2026. Inflation is expected to remain at 2.4% in 2026.

4. Downside risks to economic activity remain. Upside risks to inflation are limited.
